    with (B/n).open('x',encoding='utf8',newline='\n') as f:json.dump(x,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
def tensor(x):
    assert set(x)=={'shape','dtype','value'}
    def flat(v):
        if isinstance(v,list):
            for z in v:yield from flat(z)
        else:yield v
    a=list(flat(x['value']));assert len(a)==math.prod(x['shape']) and all(isinstance(z,(int,float,bool)) and math.isfinite(z) for z in a)
    return x['value']
